_doc: House rules and custom cards on top of Forge's scripts (shared/src/overrides.ts). Keyed by the original card id. A card keeps its id and art (image / localImage of the original card); `name`, `oracle` and script fields replace the originals. `script` lists faces; each given field (abilities, triggers, statics, replacements, keywords, svars, name) replaces that face's field. `original` is the printed name, which still resolves in deck and cube lists.
